newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile blue chips end smidgen higher, trade erratic.
newsitem.headline: Chile blue chips end smidgen higher, trade erratic.

text.p: Chilean shares seesawed to close a shade higher, with the market shedding most early gains in erratic year-end trade, said dealers.
The bolsa is expected to hold steady at the opening with the market dominated by portfolio reshuffling from institutional investors, they said.
The selective .IPSA index, which had firmed 0.4 percent midday, ended up 0.04 percent at 88.76 points. The general .IGPA index gained 0.12 percent at 4,919.78 points.
Turnover was a strong 16 billion pesos boosted by a number of stock offerings, including of power giant Endesa shares.
Traders also noted increased interest in the morning from foreign investors keen to snap up bargains after the market's recent weakness.
Decliners included telecom Entel, which continued its recent correction as investors believe the stock is overvalued, said traders.
Other decliners included brewery CCU, down 0.75 percent at 1,330 pesos, and winery Concha y Toro, which shed 0.58 percent to 188 pesos.
Winners included forestry firm Masisa, up 1.08 percent at 187 pesos, bottler Andina, up 0.97 percent at 2,080 pesos, and steel-maker Cap, which rose 0.61 percent to 830 pesos.
